question: Which values are used by digital systems to represent information?
urdu_translation: digital systems information کو represent کرنے کے لیے کون سی values استعمال کرتے ہیں؟
A: 0 to 7 / 0 سے 7
B: 0 and 1 / 0 اور 1
C: Continuous values only / صرف continuous values
D: Letters A to F only / صرف A سے F letters
correct_answer: B | 0 and 1 / 0 اور 1

question: How does an analog signal change with time?
urdu_translation: analog signal وقت کے ساتھ کس طرح change ہوتا ہے؟
A: Only between 0 and 1 / صرف 0 اور 1 کے درمیان
B: In fixed text characters / fixed text characters میں
C: Only once per second / صرف ایک بار فی second
D: Smoothly and continuously / smoothly اور continuously
correct_answer: D | Smoothly and continuously / smoothly اور continuously

question: Which of the following is an example of an analog signal?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل میں سے کون analog signal کی مثال ہے؟
A: Voice signal / آواز کا signal
B: Binary data in a computer / کمپیوٹر میں binary data
C: A Boolean truth table / Boolean truth table
D: A digital file name / digital file name
correct_answer: A | Voice signal / آواز کا signal

question: What is the purpose of an ADC?
urdu_translation: ADC کا مقصد کیا ہے؟
A: To convert digital signals into sound only / digital signals کو صرف sound میں بدلنا
B: To simplify Boolean expressions / Boolean expressions کو simplify کرنا
C: To convert an analog signal into a digital signal / analog signal کو digital signal میں convert کرنا
D: To back up computer data / computer data کا backup بنانا
correct_answer: C | To convert an analog signal into a digital signal / analog signal کو digital signal میں convert کرنا

question: What is the purpose of a DAC?
urdu_translation: DAC کا مقصد کیا ہے؟
A: To convert analog signals into binary data / analog signals کو binary data میں convert کرنا
B: To detect RAM failure / RAM failure detect کرنا
C: To convert a digital signal into an analog signal / digital signal کو analog signal میں convert کرنا
D: To create a truth table / truth table بنانا
correct_answer: C | To convert a digital signal into an analog signal / digital signal کو analog signal میں convert کرنا

question: Why are digital signals suitable for long-distance transmission and storage?
urdu_translation: digital signals long-distance transmission اور storage کے لیے موزوں کیوں ہیں؟
A: They are less affected by noise and signal degradation / وہ noise اور signal degradation سے کم متاثر ہوتے ہیں
B: They can have infinitely many values / ان کی infinitely many values ہو سکتی ہیں
C: They do not require any device / انہیں کسی device کی ضرورت نہیں
D: They are always audible to humans / وہ ہمیشہ انسانوں کو سنائی دیتے ہیں
correct_answer: A | They are less affected by noise and signal degradation / وہ noise اور signal degradation سے کم متاثر ہوتے ہیں

question: Boolean algebra mainly uses which two logical values?
urdu_translation: Boolean algebra بنیادی طور پر کون سی دو logical values استعمال کرتا ہے؟
A: High and Medium / High اور Medium
B: Positive and Neutral / Positive اور Neutral
C: Text and Image / Text اور Image
D: True and False / True اور False
correct_answer: D | True and False / True اور False

question: Which symbol is used for the AND operation in the chapter?
urdu_translation: chapter میں AND operation کے لیے کون سا symbol استعمال ہوا ہے؟
A: A plus sign (+) / plus sign (+)
B: A dot (·) / dot (·)
C: A bar only / صرف bar
D: A division sign (÷) / division sign (÷)
correct_answer: B | A dot (·) / dot (·)

question: When does an AND operation produce an output of 1?
urdu_translation: AND operation output 1 کب produce کرتا ہے؟
A: When at least one input is 1 / جب کم از کم ایک input 1 ہو
B: Only when both inputs are 1 / صرف جب دونوں inputs 1 ہوں
C: Only when both inputs are 0 / صرف جب دونوں inputs 0 ہوں
D: Whenever the inputs are different / جب inputs مختلف ہوں
correct_answer: B | Only when both inputs are 1 / صرف جب دونوں inputs 1 ہوں

question: What is the output of A · B when A = 1 and B = 0?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل values کے لیے A · B کا output کیا ہے: A = 1, B = 0

question: When does an OR operation produce an output of 0?
urdu_translation: OR operation output 0 کب produce کرتا ہے؟
A: Only when both inputs are 0 / صرف جب دونوں inputs 0 ہوں
B: Only when both inputs are 1 / صرف جب دونوں inputs 1 ہوں
C: When at least one input is 1 / جب کم از کم ایک input 1 ہو
D: Whenever the inputs are different / جب inputs مختلف ہوں
correct_answer: A | Only when both inputs are 0 / صرف جب دونوں inputs 0 ہوں

question: What is the output of A + B when A = 1 and B = 0?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل values کے لیے A + B کا output کیا ہے: A = 1, B = 0

question: How many inputs does the NOT operation use?
urdu_translation: NOT operation کتنے inputs استعمال کرتا ہے؟
A: Two inputs / دو inputs
B: Three inputs / تین inputs
C: One input / ایک input
D: No input / کوئی input نہیں
correct_answer: C | One input / ایک input

question: What is NOT 1?
urdu_translation: NOT 1 کا output کیا ہے؟

question: What is a Boolean function?
urdu_translation: Boolean function کیا ہے؟
A: A method of formatting a hard drive / hard drive format کرنے کا method
B: A list of hardware prices / hardware prices کی list
C: A type of analog signal / analog signal کی قسم
D: An algebraic statement relating binary variables through logical operations / ایک algebraic statement جو binary variables کو logical operations کے ذریعے relate کرے
correct_answer: D | An algebraic statement relating binary variables through logical operations / ایک algebraic statement جو binary variables کو logical operations کے ذریعے relate کرے

question: What does a truth table show?
urdu_translation: truth table کیا دکھاتی ہے؟
A: Only one selected input / صرف ایک selected input
B: Outputs for all possible input combinations / تمام possible input combinations کے outputs
C: The physical size of a gate / gate کا physical size
D: The price of a digital circuit / digital circuit کی price
correct_answer: B | Outputs for all possible input combinations / تمام possible input combinations کے outputs

question: Which gate corresponds to the Boolean AND operation?
urdu_translation: کون سا gate Boolean AND operation کے مطابق ہے؟
A: OR gate
B: AND gate
C: NOT gate
D: XOR gate
correct_answer: B | AND gate

question: Which gate outputs 1 when at least one input is 1?
urdu_translation: کون سا gate کم از کم ایک input 1 ہونے پر output 1 دیتا ہے؟
A: AND gate
B: NOT gate
C: Buffer only / صرف Buffer
D: OR gate
correct_answer: D | OR gate

question: What is the purpose of simplifying a Boolean function?
urdu_translation: Boolean function کو simplify کرنے کا مقصد کیا ہے؟
A: To optimize digital circuits by reducing complexity / complexity کم کرکے digital circuits کو optimize کرنا
B: To convert all signals to analog / تمام signals کو analog بنانا
C: To increase the number of gates unnecessarily / gates کی تعداد غیر ضروری بڑھانا
D: To delete every binary variable / ہر binary variable delete کرنا
correct_answer: A | To optimize digital circuits by reducing complexity / complexity کم کرکے digital circuits کو optimize کرنا

question: What is the dual of A · 0 = 0?
urdu_translation: درج ذیل Boolean identity کا dual کیا ہے: A · 0 = 0
A: A + 0 = A
B: A · 1 = A

question: Which Boolean law states that A + 0 = A?
urdu_translation: کون سا Boolean law یہ بیان کرتا ہے: A + 0 = A
A: Complement law
B: De Morgan’s law
C: Identity law
D: Absorption law
correct_answer: C | Identity law

question: Which expression represents the complement law for OR?
urdu_translation: کون سا expression OR کے complement law کو represent کرتا ہے؟
B: A + 0 = A
C: A · 1 = A
D: A + A = A

question: Which expression represents the idempotent law for AND?
urdu_translation: کون سا expression AND کے idempotent law کو represent کرتا ہے؟
D: A · A = A
correct_answer: D | A · A = A

question: What does a logic diagram represent?
urdu_translation: logic diagram کیا represent کرتا ہے؟
A: Only the physical colour of wires / صرف wires کا physical colour
B: The structure and connections of logic gates in a digital circuit / digital circuit میں logic gates کی structure اور connections
C: A list of software updates / software updates کی list
D: The storage capacity of a hard drive / hard drive کی storage capacity
correct_answer: B | The structure and connections of logic gates in a digital circuit / digital circuit میں logic gates کی structure اور connections

question: Why are logic diagrams useful?
urdu_translation: logic diagrams کیوں useful ہیں؟
A: They replace all truth tables with analog signals / وہ تمام truth tables کو analog signals سے replace کرتے ہیں
B: They visually show how gates are connected to implement a Boolean function / وہ visually دکھاتے ہیں کہ Boolean function implement کرنے کے لیے gates کیسے connected ہیں
C: They diagnose every hardware failure automatically / وہ ہر hardware failure خودکار diagnose کرتے ہیں
D: They store backups in the cloud / وہ cloud میں backups store کرتے ہیں
correct_answer: B | They visually show how gates are connected to implement a Boolean function / وہ visually دکھاتے ہیں کہ Boolean function implement کرنے کے لیے gates کیسے connected ہیں

question: What is the first step in the systematic troubleshooting process?
urdu_translation: systematic troubleshooting process کا پہلا step کیا ہے؟
A: Implement the solution / solution implement کرنا
B: Document the findings / findings document کرنا
C: Replace all hardware / تمام hardware replace کرنا
D: Identify the problem / problem کو identify کرنا
correct_answer: D | Identify the problem / problem کو identify کرنا

question: After identifying a problem, what should be done next?
urdu_translation: problem identify کرنے کے بعد اگلا step کیا ہونا چاہیے؟
A: Establish a theory of probable cause / probable cause کی theory قائم کرنا
B: Immediately discard the computer / فوراً کمپیوٹر discard کرنا
C: Skip directly to documentation / براہ راست documentation پر جانا
D: Disable all backups / تمام backups disable کرنا
correct_answer: A | Establish a theory of probable cause / probable cause کی theory قائم کرنا

question: What is the purpose of testing a theory of probable cause?
urdu_translation: probable cause کی theory test کرنے کا مقصد کیا ہے؟
A: To create a new operating system / نیا operating system بنانا
B: To hide the original problem / اصل problem چھپانا
C: To determine whether the suspected cause is correct / یہ determine کرنا کہ suspected cause درست ہے یا نہیں
D: To avoid verifying the system / system verification سے بچنا
correct_answer: C | To determine whether the suspected cause is correct / یہ determine کرنا کہ suspected cause درست ہے یا نہیں

question: Which step follows implementation of a troubleshooting solution?
urdu_translation: troubleshooting solution implement کرنے کے بعد کون سا step آتا ہے؟
A: Identify the problem again without testing / بغیر test کیے problem دوبارہ identify کرنا
B: Remove all documentation / تمام documentation remove کرنا
C: Verify full system functionality / full system functionality verify کرنا
D: Establish a different random cause / random different cause قائم کرنا
correct_answer: C | Verify full system functionality / full system functionality verify کرنا

question: What is the final step of systematic troubleshooting?
urdu_translation: systematic troubleshooting کا final step کیا ہے؟
A: Document findings, actions, and outcomes / findings، actions اور outcomes document کرنا
B: Disconnect every cable / ہر cable disconnect کرنا
C: Delete all system files / تمام system files delete کرنا
D: Ignore the result / result ignore کرنا
correct_answer: A | Document findings, actions, and outcomes / findings، actions اور outcomes document کرنا

question: How does troubleshooting help reduce downtime?
urdu_translation: troubleshooting downtime کم کرنے میں کیسے مدد کرتا ہے؟
A: By stopping all maintenance / تمام maintenance روک کر
B: By increasing software conflicts / software conflicts بڑھا کر
C: By preventing users from working / users کو کام سے روک کر
D: By identifying and resolving problems quickly / problems کو جلد identify اور resolve کرکے
correct_answer: D | By identifying and resolving problems quickly / problems کو جلد identify اور resolve کرکے

question: What does data integrity mean?
urdu_translation: data integrity کا کیا مطلب ہے؟
A: Data is always deleted after use / data use کے بعد ہمیشہ delete ہو
B: Data remains accurate and reliable / data accurate اور reliable رہے
C: Every file is converted to an image / ہر file image میں convert ہو
D: Only passwords are stored / صرف passwords store ہوں
correct_answer: B | Data remains accurate and reliable / data accurate اور reliable رہے

question: Which issue can cause a computer to slow down, freeze, or shut down unexpectedly?
urdu_translation: کون سا issue کمپیوٹر کو slow، freeze یا unexpectedly shut down کر سکتا ہے؟
A: A labelled cable / labelled cable
B: Overheating / اوور ہیٹنگ
C: A strong password / strong password
D: A completed backup / completed backup
correct_answer: B | Overheating / اوور ہیٹنگ

question: Which tool can be used to diagnose RAM problems?
urdu_translation: RAM problems diagnose کرنے کے لیے کون سا tool استعمال ہو سکتا ہے؟
A: A web browser only / صرف web browser
B: A word processor / word processor
C: A media player / media player
D: Windows Memory Diagnostic
correct_answer: D | Windows Memory Diagnostic

question: Which symptom may indicate a hard-drive failure?
urdu_translation: کون سی symptom hard-drive failure کی نشاندہی کر سکتی ہے؟
A: Clicking noises and corrupted files / clicking noises اور corrupted files
B: Improved boot speed / بہتر boot speed
C: A brighter monitor / زیادہ روشن monitor
D: A stronger password / زیادہ strong password
correct_answer: A | Clicking noises and corrupted files / clicking noises اور corrupted files

question: What does SMART help monitor?
urdu_translation: SMART کس چیز کو monitor کرنے میں مدد دیتا ہے؟
A: Printer ink colour / printer ink colour
B: Keyboard layout / keyboard layout
C: Hard-drive health / hard-drive health
D: Website design / website design
correct_answer: C | Hard-drive health / hard-drive health

question: What should be done before replacing a hard drive?
urdu_translation: hard drive replace کرنے سے پہلے کیا کرنا چاہیے؟
A: Delete the operating system without backup / backup کے بغیر operating system delete کرنا
B: Disconnect the monitor permanently / monitor permanently disconnect کرنا
C: Back up the data / data کا backup بنانا
D: Remove all RAM first / پہلے تمام RAM remove کرنا
correct_answer: C | Back up the data / data کا backup بنانا

question: How can adding more RAM improve a computer?
urdu_translation: مزید RAM add کرنے سے کمپیوٹر کیسے improve ہو سکتا ہے؟
A: It can improve performance during multitasking / یہ multitasking کے دوران performance improve کر سکتا ہے
B: It converts digital signals to analog / یہ digital signals کو analog میں convert کرتا ہے
C: It replaces the need for a CPU / یہ CPU کی ضرورت ختم کرتا ہے
D: It guarantees unlimited storage / یہ unlimited storage guarantee کرتا ہے
correct_answer: A | It can improve performance during multitasking / یہ multitasking کے دوران performance improve کر سکتا ہے

question: Why should software updates and patches be installed regularly?
urdu_translation: software updates اور patches regularly install کیوں کرنے چاہییں؟
A: To create more cable disconnections / مزید cable disconnections بنانے کے لیے
B: To reduce storage by deleting all files / تمام files delete کرکے storage کم کرنے کے لیے
C: To disable security software / security software disable کرنے کے لیے
D: To fix bugs and protect against vulnerabilities / bugs fix کرنے اور vulnerabilities سے protect کرنے کے لیے
correct_answer: D | To fix bugs and protect against vulnerabilities / bugs fix کرنے اور vulnerabilities سے protect کرنے کے لیے

question: What is a suitable response to software conflicts?
urdu_translation: software conflicts کے لیے مناسب response کیا ہے؟
A: Ignore compatibility issues permanently / compatibility issues permanently ignore کرنا
B: Identify and uninstall conflicting software or update affected applications / conflicting software identify اور uninstall کرنا یا affected applications update کرنا
C: Replace the monitor immediately / monitor فوراً replace کرنا
D: Convert the conflict into an analog signal / conflict کو analog signal میں convert کرنا
correct_answer: B | Identify and uninstall conflicting software or update affected applications / conflicting software identify اور uninstall کرنا یا affected applications update کرنا

question: Which backup method keeps copies of data on remote internet-based servers?
urdu_translation: کون سا backup method data کی copies remote internet-based servers پر رکھتا ہے؟
A: Cable labelling / cable labelling
B: Cloud backup / cloud backup
C: RAM replacement
D: Logic-gate backup / logic-gate backup
correct_answer: B | Cloud backup / cloud backup
